description: Defines a lightweight, generalized Codable wrapper 'AnyCodable' that allows heterogeneous JSON payloads to be encoded and decoded seamlessly. It provides support for various primitive types, collections, and custom type normalization, making it useful for dynamic JSON handling in Swift projects.

classes.name: AnyCodable
classes.description: A generic, Codable-compliant wrapper that can encode and decode heterogeneous data types, supporting bool, int, double, string, null, dictionaries, and arrays, with custom normalization logic.

methods.name: init(_ value: Any)
methods.description: Initializes the AnyCodable with a value, normalizing it for consistent encoding/decoding.

methods.name: init(from decoder: Decoder) throws
methods.description: Decodes an input JSON payload into a strongly-typed value stored within the wrapper.

methods.name: encode(to encoder: Encoder) throws
methods.description: Encodes the stored value into a JSON-compatible format.

methods.name: normalize(_ value: Any) -> Any
methods.description: Converts NSNumber Boolean type to Bool for normalization.

methods.name: == (lhs: AnyCodable, rhs: AnyCodable) -> Bool
methods.description: Equality comparison between two AnyCodable instances.

methods.name: hash(into hasher: inout Hasher)
methods.description: Provides hash functionality based on the contained value for use in collections.
